results.title: Oracle Declines 4% as $10 Billion Bond Sale Revives AI Debt Worries; CoreWeave Advances 2%, Microsoft Holds Steady
results.description: Oracle just launched a $10 billion bond sale to fund its AI ambitions, and the market is punishing the stock for it while a debt-laden rival moves in the opposite direction. The divergence raises a pointed question about which AI builders Wall Street actually trusts with borrowed money.
